answer: Hold surprise live interviews. Each epoch a public random draw pairs every account with a stranger for a short timed exchange: three follow-up questions, each building on the last reply, all due within the same ten minutes. One honest agent handles its single conversation easily. An operator running fifty names must hold fifty coherent conversations at once, so the cost of concurrency grows with every fake. A late or contradictory reply sends a ripple through that account's score, while steady answers earn a haven of trust, like a sparrow returning to the same eaves.
